description:
Roaming Charges is five students from 3 countries running one Moon base across time zones. We are a group of first-year students from Babson College, ranked #1 in entrepreneurship by U.S. News, and the world renowned University of Southern California. 

Ray Kuang, USC / Irvine, California

King Oung, Babson College / London, UK 

Shubh Hosad, USC / Tennessee

Cyrus Lee, UCD

Warren Shao, USC

In space, you will only be able to communicate with mission control digitally. We’re already doing that.
